name: Ethiopia
food_narrative: Eating Injera from one massive plate is how we show community. You have to eat it with your right hand!
food_query: Gursha Ethiopian Restaurant, Grand Rapids, MI
history_narrative: Lalibela's rock-hewn churches are a testament to ancient architecture and faith.
culture_narrative: The traditional coffee ceremony (Buna) is a cornerstone of our social life. It is an unwritten rule that you take the time to sit, smell the roasting beans, and connect with guests. It is never rushed.

name: Kenya
food_narrative: Authentic Nyama Choma at a weekend gathering is a whole social event back home.
history_narrative: The Maasai Mara isn't just a reserve; it represents the deep connection between the land and the Maasai people.
culture_narrative: The concept of 'Harambee' (pulling together) defines our community support system. There is also a deep, unspoken respect for elders—you always greet them first and offer them the best seats.
